drivingQuestion: From where do we know that thanks-offering loaves and nazirite wafers made for oneself do not fulfil the matza obligation?
outcomeNote: The unit breaks off mid-answer; Rabba's verse and its development continue in pesachim.sugya091.

segments.he: חַלַּת תּוֹדָה וּרְקִיקֵי נָזִיר וְכוּ׳. מְנָא הָנֵי מִילֵּי? אָמַר רַבָּה: דְּאָמַר קְרָא
segments.en: We learned in the mishna that if one prepared the «loaves of a thanks-offering or a nazirite’s wafers» for himself, he cannot use them to fulfill his obligation to eat matza on Passover. The Gemara asks: «From where are these matters» derived? «Rabba said: As the verse states:»
